Air Canada official Summer-2026 network announcement with exact route, flight number, weekdays and seasonal validity for selected services. Year-round rows are route evidence here unless a finite timetable window is independently established.

Air India official international connectivity map says it flies nonstop to 41 destinations and draws bidirectional arrows between each listed overseas airport and the named Indian airport(s). It is a broad route-universe snapshot, not a current dated timetable; later current advisories and route launches override it where applicable.
Air India official release adds DEL-HAN/HAN-DEL from 2026-05-01 and BOM-HND/HND-BOM from 2026-06-15 with exact Air India flight identities. These pairs postdate the February route-map snapshot.

Current Air India homepage advisory states all Air India flights to all Middle East destinations are suspended. Middle East pairs shown on the February route map are therefore not inserted as current positive route evidence in this round.
SWISS' current nonstop flightplan lists LX52/LX54 ZRH-BOS and LX53/LX55 BOS-ZRH without a partner-operator label. The exact airport pair is retained as current route/operator evidence only.

Austrian's current nonstop flightplan identifies OS7 VIE-BKK and the paired BKK-VIE service; the reverse Austrian page independently identifies that service as OS8. No route-wide schedule horizon is inferred.

Austrian's current nonstop flightplan identifies OS31 VIE-BOS and OS32 BOS-VIE on the exact airport pair. The live pair page is used as current route/operator evidence only; no recurring schedule horizon is inferred.

Thai Airways' Amsterdam route publication gives exact TG936 BKK-AMS and TG937 AMS-BKK identities and a Sep-Nov 2026 travel period; its terms restrict the promotion to TG flights operated by THAI. Used as current route/operator evidence, not as a complete dated timetable.

The Bangkok-origin THAI promotion lists Taipei among destinations and describes the promoted Bangkok services as nonstop; its terms limit flight availability to TG flights operated by THAI. Only BKK-TPE is combined with a separate exact-airport route page below; other city names are not expanded into airports.

Current Thai Airways fare page resolves the Bangkok-Taipei city pair as BKK-TPE. It is used only to resolve the airport pair alongside the separate nonstop/operating-carrier publication, never as standalone operator evidence.

THAI's Early Escape 2026 page explicitly says the listed Bangkok services are non-stop and limits eligibility to TG 3-digit operating flights only for travel 2026-09-01 through 2026-11-30. City labels are accepted only where the separate current Bangkok route surface resolves the exact airport code; no reverse direction is inferred.

Current THAI Bangkok-origin inventory resolves exact airport pairs including ICN, NRT, HND, KIX, PVG, HKG, SIN, LHR, CTS, PEK and CAN. Combined with the separate operated-nonstop promotion only; fare inventory by itself is not operator/nonstop evidence.
LOT confirms Warsaw-Bologna service launched 2026-03-31 with outbound and return flights. Used as exact current route evidence.

LOT's current first-flight page explicitly calls the listed services inaugural LOT Polish Airlines flights and gives directional LOT flight identities for WAW-ALA / ALA-WAW, WAW-SFO / SFO-WAW, GDN-BRU / BRU-GDN, GDN-OSL / OSL-GDN, and KRK-ROME/MAD/BCN with their returns. LOT confirms direct LOT Polish Airlines flights from Gdansk to Brussels, Oslo and Bergen are operating and explicitly describes return flights. GCMP only imports destinations whose exact airport identity is independently resolved below; Bergen is withheld in this tranche.
LOT's current direct Gdansk-Brussels route page resolves the destination as Brussels Airport (BRU). Used only with the separate LOT-operated/direct publication and directional flight identities.

LOT confirms its three new direct Krakow routes to Rome, Barcelona and Madrid launched 2026-03-30 and are part of its year-round network. Reverse directions are accepted only because the separate current first-flight page explicitly publishes return LOT flight identities.

LOT's current Krakow-origin page identifies Krakow-Balice Airport (KRK) and separately lists direct flights to Rome, Barcelona and Madrid. It is used as current direct-route corroboration, not as a complete LOT network index.
LOT's current Barcelona destination surface resolves Barcelona to El Prat Airport (BCN). It supplies airport identity only alongside the separate KRK direct/operator and directional evidence.

AEGEAN's current flight-status board exposes exact airport pairs and distinguishes rows labeled Aegean Airlines from OlympicAir. GCMP retains only directions explicitly shown as Aegean Airlines on the reviewed current board; OA rows are excluded and no reverse direction is inferred unless separately shown.

Royal Jordanian's Quick Reference Timetable No.473 is explicitly valid 01Sep-30Sep 2026 and publishes exact airport codes, directional flight identities and special From/To AQJ/ADJ rows. Its legend marks one-stop services with * and RO/GF/WY-operated codeshare aircraft with #; the reviewed September flight rows contain no # marker and YYZ is the only * one-stop city row. GCMP retains only exact direct legs that can be represented without decomposing the YYZ through service.
Current Brussels Airlines flightplan lists SN501 BRU-JFK and SN502 JFK-BRU, while separately marking EWR marketing rows as operated by UA. Only the SN-operated JFK pair is retained.

Shenzhen Airlines' current 2026 international coupon terms require flights sold by ZH and actually operated by ZH, explicitly exclude codeshares, and enumerate applicable directional international routes for 2026-08-23..09-23 and 2026-10-04..12-31. GCMP retains the exact airport-resolved routes only; coupon dates do not become recurring schedule evidence.

EVA Air's current airline-owned fare surface lists BKK-TPE throughout September 2026, including 2026-09-08. Used only as current directional route evidence; fare inventory is not promoted to an exact flight number or recurring timetable.
